explicit_external_requirements: Actual matching source/build/binary receipt and source hashes before/after execution.
Coordinator verifies exact systemd InvocationID, bounded wall clock, outer-unit OOM/max counters, current Main epoch and final exact unit/cgroup cleanup.
No pressure run should be called accepted based only on qualifier exit status without those external receipts.

findings.impact: The joined audit is not a complete record of actual consumed observations. A late event can be missing from an apparently complete stale-queue qualification audit. This is an audit/qualification defect, not evidence of a real device kill.
findings.observed_source_behavior: Control readiness breaks before any monitor observation counter is incremented. Cancellation uses stop_reason 1. Prior observations/queued/record counts may remain equal; terminal from_retirement can mark incomplete false although this successful poll consumed an unaccounted PSI event.
findings.precondition: One successful poll returns cancellation/control readiness and a monitor POLLPRI in the same result.
findings.required_fix: Account for every monitor POLLPRI returned by a successful poll before any control/revalidation/error exit, while retaining cancellation priority and sending no event after cancellation. Any consumed but unsent event must make terminal audit incomplete.
findings.verification: Exact source path; no real device PSI execution in this review.

findings.impact: A delayed second victim from the tested daemon can escape the intended zero-extra-victim and preserved-foreground acceptance checks. Native kill counters are not queried again after this window, and a SIGKILL need not change kernel OOM counters.
findings.observed_source_behavior: The cleanup loop only checks and waits children when alive_fd is true. Already-dead unexpected targets are silently skipped and their descriptors closed; phase-result may still be written ok=true.
findings.precondition: An unexpected foreground/protected/other owned target dies after the last kill-count/liveness checks but before exact LMKD exit and the cleanup loop.
findings.required_fix: After exact LMKD reap, revalidate every target that should still live. Require individual Q, exact wait/reap and exit0 for all those targets; only the already-proven and reaped cached SIGKILL victim may be skipped. Retain exact per-target identity and exit classification in an externally pinned cleanup receipt required by the qualifier.
findings.status: source-confirmed and exact-statement local owned-child reproduction; implementing agent accepted

next_revision_note: Implementing agent will produce a new freeze06; freeze05 stays byte-identical. No next-revision approval is implied.
reviewed_properties: Initial domain hard=512MiB high=384MiB swap=0 is configured before authority and re-read during pressure; no later lowering of thresholds or budgets is implemented in the inspected path.

4MiB allocator steps require 16MiB reserve under observed 432MiB cap and stop requesting more work after the first observed cached exit; one in-flight bounded chunk can complete. Cap is explicitly observed, not a continuous kernel-enforced 432MiB limit.
Actual registration audit stores the bytes successfully written to held pressure descriptors and their inode/device; both fixed 70ms some and 700ms full in 1000ms windows are required.
Audit transport is nonce/generation/scope/budget bound; terminal audit is unavailable from LifecycleBroker until exact terminal status and broker process reap.

Queued event audit requires per-level consecutive sequences, monotonic order, send within original window, bounded capacity, and matching observation/queue/record counts; the identified early-exit observation gap must still be fixed.
Qualifier pins complete evidence file sets through external manifest/source hashes, descriptor-bound regular file reads, exact lengths/hashes, duplicate-key rejection, and no symlinks.

Positive narrow pass requires a fresh critical queued event correlated before the observed cached pidfd exit, exact cached identity/SIGKILL, native notification and diagnostic; medium-only returns partial. The actual native critical decision is separately reported and must not be inferred from qualification_status alone.

Stale narrow pass requires real events while exact LMKD is stopped, all recorded events aged before resume, retained above-high zero-kill observation and later allocator-only relief with unchanged budget. Audit completeness and final target cleanup must first be repaired.

Owned driver checks exact unit cgroup, 1CPU/512MiB/swap0/64tasks, fresh owned roots and independent namespaces; final broker/init ownership and domain-empty proof are distinct from the external unit/Main fence.
